title: Microsoft 365 admin center: refreshed Copilot landing page with usage and security views
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, security dashboard roles and report privacy control are supported. Correct the unsupported assertion about which page most Copilot owners open first, clarify the general licensing background, and complete the usage-report route; these findings do not block publication.
